findings.area: spec fidelity / gate honesty (FR-SHP-002, FR-SHP-004, ADR-0016 item 2)
findings.detail: shape-view.tsx never reads ShapeDef.defaultStyle (theme defaults apply to every def) and fills every outline, open ones included, although ADR-0016 item 2 says open outlines have no fill; text-box and freehand defaults are dead data; no row or leg covers it.
findings.failure_scenario: M5.24 records goldens and baselines with a stroked, surface-filled text-box and filled polyline/freehand polygons; every m5-complete leg stays green.

findings.detail: parseShapeDef checks templates and expressions only as strings; it never parses them or checks the identifiers of outlines, decorations and handles, so a definition that registers can fail every evaluateOutline, and handle typos go unnoticed until M7.
findings.failure_scenario: A pack ships a handle y of "2 * hh" or an outline typo {w - rr}; register() returns ok; the outline shows as a placeholder at render time, the handle typo lands unnoticed.

findings.detail: M5.20 has packs/basic register marker definitions, but PackSpec has only shapes, PackRegistries picks shapeDefs, and the markers registry is unknown in core; the row does not name the SDK contract growth.
findings.failure_scenario: The M5.20 author registers the ER markers from render or the CLI host under basic: to pass the gallery check (a dogfooding violation), or grows definePack without weighing it as a contract change.

findings.detail: The docs leg only checks that stub (M1) is gone from three READMEs; the FR-CON-012 leg checks a passing title, not the 1000 runs the plan names; no coverage floor applies to packs/basic.
findings.failure_scenario: One-line READMEs and a 100-run property pass the gate while the plan is not met.

dispositions.target: M5.30 (new, before M5.24) + m5-complete shape-views leg
dispositions.note: The shape view merges ShapeDef.defaultStyle under the element style (theme under both) and strokes open outlines without fill; the gate names the title.
parseShapeDef parses every template and expression and checks the identifiers each may read (outline, decorations, handles; i and n only in a polygon); the gate names the title.

M5.20 names the SDK contract change: a core marker definition type, PackSpec.markers and PackRegistries widened to markers, recorded as an ADR-0017 amendment; the gate also names the pack-marker title (the pending M5.1 review minor).
The docs leg checks README content, the FR-CON-012 leg checks the 1000-run count, and packs/basic gets a coverage floor, each with a harness case.

planDelta: Three rows added (M5.30-M5.32) and M5.20 amended; rows at 31 of 19 planned (1.6x: M4 hand-offs, the ADR row, style splits and review follow-ups). M5.7 and M5.12 exceeded the 400-line split risk: split the routing rows M5.16-M5.23 before starting them.
